FREELANCE SERVICES AGREEMENT (VERSION 1 - BALANCED)

This Agreement is entered into by Client Corp ("Client") and Independent Developer ("Freelancer").

1. PAYMENT TERMS (SECTION 1)
Client shall pay Freelancer $100 per hour. Invoices submitted bi-weekly shall be paid by Client within thirty (30) days of receipt (Net-30).

2. TERMINATION & CURE PERIOD (SECTION 2)
Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving thirty (30) days prior written notice. In the event of alleged breach, the breaching party shall be given 15 days to cure.

3. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY (SECTION 3)
The aggregate liability of Freelancer under this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid by Client in the preceding twelve (12) months.

4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY (SECTION 4)
Upon receipt of full payment, Freelancer assigns to Client all right, title, and interest in custom deliverables created under this Agreement.
